userStory.desire: As a Generator Platform Maintainer, I want one clear generator-vue ownership/entrypoint model so consumers are not split across competing invocation paths.

motivation.summary: Ownership clarity keeps generator evolution coherent and easier to support.
supportsOrUnblocks: Reduces operational ambiguity for teams adopting Wesley generators.
Prevents reintroduction of ad-hoc script wrappers around multiple entrypoints.

acceptanceCriteria: Generator-vue ownership and entrypoint are unified under one supported invocation path.
Legacy overlapping entrypoints are deprecated or removed with migration notes.
CI uses the unified entrypoint for generation validation.

assertions: CLI tests verify unified entrypoint covers previous generator-vue capabilities.
Repository docs/tests reference only the unified entrypoint.
Deprecation tests ensure old entrypoints fail with clear redirect message.
goldenPath: Run unified entrypoint in a Vue consumer and verify artifacts compile without manual adaptation.
Execute CI generation workflow and confirm unified path is exercised.
edgeCases: Existing consumer configs migrate with compatibility shim where necessary.
Unknown legacy flags fail with actionable mapping to new flags.
fuzzScale: Run unified entrypoint across multiple consumer templates to verify broad compatibility.
failureCases: Broken migration mapping fails quickly with per-flag guidance.
Entry-point resolution conflict fails startup with deterministic error.

outOfScope: Unrelated feature work outside dependency chain impact.
